name: Shardvow Mirror-Monk

Traits.name: Ringing Retort
Traits.text: Once per turn, when the mirror-monk is hit by an attack, the blow's force is caught in its glass and held until the start of its next turn, while that force is held, the mirror-monk can move up to 10 feet to intercept a creature that enters its reach, and the striker takes 17 (5d6) damage of the same type as the triggering attack or Thunder instead.
Traits.clause: The mirror-monk's glass body takes every strike as a sounding board — whenever it is hit, the blow's ringing force is ca
Traits.expresses: reflecting blows back on the attacker
Traits.expressedQuote: the striker takes 17 (5d6) damage of the same type as the triggering attack or Thunder instead.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The mirror-monk makes two attacks, using Unarmed Strike or Dart in any combination.

Actions.name: Unarmed Strike
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +9, reach 5 ft. 27 (5d8 + 5) Bludgeoning damage. Once on each of the mirror-monk's turns when it hits with this attack, the target is subjected to the following effect. *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 17. *Failure:* The target has the Stunned condition until the end of the mirror-monk's next turn.

Actions.name: Dart
Actions.text: *Ranged Attack Roll:* +6, range 20/60 ft. 29 (6d8 + 2) Piercing damage.

Bonus Actions.name: Patient Defense
Bonus Actions.text: The mirror-monk takes the Dodge action.

Bonus Actions.name: Cunning Action
Bonus Actions.text: The mirror-monk takes the Dash, Disengage, or Hide action.

lore: Fused from the shattered mirror-shields of a monastery's last defenders, the mirror-monk keeps a vault it no longer remembers, returning every intruder's violence as its own.
